sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B · EXL3 · DFlash2 - GitHub
sources.snippet: by Mia'a AI Lab Deployment kit for serving Qwen3.8-27B quantized to EXL3 3.5bpw with speculative decoding — MTP by default (draft head inside the checkpoint, best context per GB) or DFlash2 (EXL3 5.0bpw draft model, ~15% faster) — plus an NVFP4 KV cache lane for maximum context per GB. This repo contains the launcher, server and configuration.
